name: remesso-agent-wallet
description: MCP server for the Remesso Claude plugin: an agent wallet whose spending is capped on-chain by RemessoAgentAllowance.

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/server.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node scripts/strip-bytecode.mjs dist/server.mjs
